comparison.objective: Disconnect a pneumatic tube and install a blanking plug; candidate extracts a crimp terminal from a housing.
comparison.physical_skill: Close valve, depress an annular collet, withdraw tube, then align and insert plug; candidate depresses two recessed tangs with a dedicated dual-blade tool while coordinating push-then-pull on a wire.
comparison.success_condition: Tube released and port blanked only after isolation versus one terminal extracted with wire attached, neighbors retained, and reusable housing undamaged.
comparison.reason: Both centrally test sustaining a connector release feature while withdrawing the retained line/component. The candidate adds finer dual-blade access and neighbor protection, but those are difficulty and geometry differences around the same release-and-pull ability.
